caveats: Emulator HOS/cross fidelity limits stacked SBI -- the 5.2sigma artifact (section 3d) is a methods warning, not a physics result (WORKLOG 2026-06-29)
TNG-only + fixed cosmology throughout; cross-suite/cosmology generalization untested (wl_stat_latents.py docstring; WORKLOG 2026-06-24)
n=253 design points in 30-D -- interpolation within the Sobol prior-predictive cloud, not extrapolation (label on f1_corr_heatmaps.png; WORKLOG 2026-06-29)
Per-halo map link (Born delta-kappa) is fiducial-only -- Sobol runs have no lensplanes, only randomized ray-traced kappa_maps.npz (WORKLOG 2026-06-29 section 6 entry)
WST excluded from wl_stat_latents.py cross-statistic comparison -- only 40 valid runs at that point (WORKLOG 2026-06-24)
Two disagreeing global-sensitivity metrics exist (Spearman vs Sobol-index); Spearman is the one WORKLOG endorses for the headline figure, Sobol-index is deprecated per wl_latent_sbi.py docstring

Per-halo population SBI on 8.6M halos was never run to a completed GPU result -- notebook explicitly falls back to a small inline DEMO model labeled 'illustration only, not the science result'; no cached population_posterior.npz found on disk

The DES Y3xACT shear x y real-data result went through 3 corrections in one WORKLOG entry plus a further correction 2 days later; use the final (2026-06-26) '~1.5-2x high, too steep' number, not the initial '~2x too weak' pipeline-bug read still present in desact_sheary_realfit.py's stale docstring
